strings.name: François-Henri Pinault
strings.summary: After working in his family’s timber, distribution and retail businesses, Pinault led PPR’s transition into luxury group Kering, home to Gucci and Saint Laurent. He promoted environmental accounting and initiatives against violence toward women. He relinquished the CEO role in 2025 while remaining chairman, became chairman of Christie’s in 2026 and continues to participate in the family investment business.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; reviewed on 15 November. This is not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Led Kering’s shift toward luxury-brand management and participates in the global fashion industry and sustainability debates.

strings.highlights.h1.title: Group transformation
strings.highlights.h1.text: Led PPR’s disposal of retail businesses and concentration on luxury brands; it became Kering in 2013.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Social and environmental issues
strings.highlights.h2.text: Created the Kering Foundation in 2008 to combat violence against women and promoted corporate environmental accounting.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Became Christie’s chairman
strings.timeline.t1.text: Appointed chairman and non-executive director, distinct from the auction house’s CEO.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Handed over Kering CEO role
strings.timeline.t2.text: Handed the CEO role to Luca de Meo while remaining board chairman.
strings.timeline.t3.title: PPR renamed Kering
strings.timeline.t3.text: PPR adopted the Kering name as the group concentrated on luxury.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Established Kering Foundation
strings.timeline.t4.text: Established a foundation supporting action against violence toward women.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Became PPR chairman and CEO
strings.timeline.t5.text: Became the group’s chairman and chief executive.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Became Artémis chairman
strings.timeline.t6.text: Became chairman of the family’s investment holding company.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Joined Pinault group
strings.timeline.t7.text: Joined the Pinault group and subsequently held subsidiary management roles.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Graduated from HEC
strings.timeline.t8.text: Completed business-school studies before military service at the French consulate in Los Angeles.
